title: Bart Van Aerle to speak at Autogas Day in Istanbul
summary: Bart Van Aerle to speak at Autogas Day in Istanbul
body_markdown:
On October 15, as part of **Liquid Gas Week 2026** , our **CEO Bart Van Aerle** will be a speaker at **Autogas Day** —an international event dedicated to the role of Autogas in the future of mobility and the sector’s development prospects.


During his presentation, Bart Van Aerle will provide an overview of the global Autogas market, analyzing key dynamics and concrete growth opportunities in strategic markets. This event offers an opportunity to present Westport Fuel Systems’ perspective within the international dialogue on the evolution of gas-powered mobility.


**Autogas Day** will take place during **Liquid Gas Week** in Istanbul, Turkey (October 12–16). Organized by the WLGA, this premier international event brings together companies, institutions, and stakeholders from across the entire liquid gas value chain.


Westport Fuel Systems will also be present in the event’s exhibition area, showcasing its systems and solutions for gas-powered mobility, and will serve as a sponsor of the Autogas Village.


Participation in **Liquid Gas Week** —and specifically our CEO’s presence at Autogas Day—underscores Westport Fuel Systems’ commitment to contributing to the international conversation regarding the future of Autogas and the sector’s development opportunities.


More:[https://www.liquidgasweek.com/](https://www.liquidgasweek.com/)
